notes: Major character-sheet audit update. Reworks Family, Relationships, Skills/Powers, Timeline, and Notes based on the completed field audit while preserving the previously updated Overview, Appearance, Personality, and Background direction. Family now uses structured parent, sibling, child, other-family, family-history, and visual family-tree tools. Relationships is streamlined to Relationship Status, Sexuality, Friends, Enemies (including rival types), and Mentors. Skills is replaced by a structured Powers system. Psychology is removed. Timeline is now a visual life-story timeline builder. Notes now focuses on Aliases, searchable story/trope tags, aesthetic tags, a generated mood-board view, multi-select labeled/custom color palettes, and Important Objects. Randomize controls are available throughout, with section and full-character randomization. Existing character/user data remains stored separately from app payload files, and the update does not delete prior data files.
